newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.39 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY FIXED WEAKER AT 2.39 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1350 to the dollar, down from 3.1310 on Monday and at 1.8360 to the mark, up from 1.8365, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.39 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, weaker than Monday's 2.45 percent fix.
It was at 2.44 percent from the floating parity rate, also slightly down from 2.47 percent on Monday.
